commitResults.messageTitle: Modify name of bot, added greeting and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Bot greets user upon initialisation, and program terminates after greeting.

When user types "bye", ByeCommand executes and exits the program.
For all other input, the EchoCommand executes and prints the command given

commitResults.messageTitle: Add UI class to standardise output

commitResults.messageBody: Renamed Ui class to UI and updated all imports and usages

commitResults.messageTitle: Add TaskList class and task commands
commitResults.messageBody:
TaskList stores tasks during program execution.
Add and list commands use TaskList to add new tasks and display the
currently stored tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Task domain model and mark and unmark task commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Task class stores information of inidividual tasks.
Mark and unmark task commands use TaskList to tell the specific task to modify
its state.
Feedback for invalid task numbers and repeated mark/unmark attempts are
included as well.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace generic Task class with Todo, Deadline and Event classes
commitResults.messageBody:
The new classes store additional task information, such as a due
date for Deadline and start and end times for Event. Task creation now displays more detailed information.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add ExceptionHandler and suite of ApplicationExceptions to handle exceptions in the application.
Update Command Parsers to mirror name of Commands
Add delete task command and update TaskList to use ArrayList
commitResults.messageBody: Users can now delete tasks from the TaskList and TaskList uses ArrayList to support easy deletion.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add CommandType enum to Parser class
commitResults.messageBody: CommandType maps input keywords to their respective command parsers.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor TaskList to follow Singleton pattern
commitResults.messageBody: The Singleton pattern ensures that there is only one instance of TaskList in the application.

SaveManager handles saving to and reading from local storage.

StartManager and TerminationManager handles tasks for starting up and termination respectively, including the saving and reading of task list.

commitResults.messageTitle: Update parsing rules in TaskCodec to disallow empty string as a field.
commitResults.messageBody: This mirrors the input rules of the application, where fields cannot be an empty string.

Task list data is lost whenever the application ends.

Add saving mechanism where TaskList data is saved locally when
application stops and imports the data when the application starts
